name: Pulse Border
description: Rounded corners and a window border that breathes between two colours on a smooth cycle, with an optional brightness dip at the low end. The pulse dims when the surface loses focus.
author: PlasmaZones

parameters.name: Corner radius
parameters.description: Roundness of the corners (px, 0 for square)

parameters.name: Round bottom corners
parameters.description: Round the bottom corners as well as the top. Turn off to round only the top two, for a pane that sits against a panel or the screen edge. Every pack in the chain that offers this setting follows one answer, so their bottom corners are all rounded or all square. Set it on any pack and the whole chain follows. Where two packs have it set differently, the one earliest in the chain wins.

parameters.name: Edge softness
parameters.description: Anti-alias feather of the border and the pane edge, in device pixels, so it does not grow with display scaling. Lower is a crisper hairline.

parameters.name: Pulse speed
parameters.description: How many pulse cycles play per second

parameters.name: Dip depth
parameters.description: How far the border fades at the low end of the pulse, where 0 keeps it solid

parameters.name: First colour
parameters.description: Colour at the top of the pulse

parameters.name: Second colour
parameters.description: Colour at the bottom of the pulse
